aboutpara: I am a final-year Software Engineering student with a strong background in business management and several years of professional work experience. This combination gives me a unique perspective when building applications, allowing me to think both technically and strategically. I enjoy developing practical solutions, from web applications and console systems to microcontroller projects. Through my work as a teaching assistant in mathematics and computer science subjects, I have developed strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex ideas clearly. I am curious, motivated, and committed to continuous learning and improvement.

resume.tagline: Final-year Computer Engineering student with a strong technical background and previous experience in business management.
resume.description: I am passionate about building real-world software solutions and applying both my technical and analytical skills. With experience in programming, mathematics tutoring, embedded systems, and project-based teamwork, I bring structure, communication, and problem-solving abilities to every project. My background in business management strengthens my understanding of teamwork, planning, and user-centered development.
